title: System not reporting
owner_explanation: Your system has stopped sending data. It may still be running, but problems cannot be detected while it is offline.
installer_action: Check gateway/Wi-Fi; if the smart meter shows no export, dispatch to check isolators and inverter faults.

title: Intermittent data gaps
owner_explanation: Your system dropped offline several times in the last 30 days, so some days could not be checked.
installer_action: Check Wi-Fi signal at the gateway; consider an ethernet or 4G link.

title: Solar output below expected
owner_explanation: Your panels are producing much less than the weather says they should, consistently. This usually means a string, connector or optimiser fault.
installer_action: Inspect string voltages, DC connectors and optimisers; compare per-string output.

title: Winter shading losses
owner_explanation: Output drops sharply in winter compared with summer, a typical sign of shading when the sun is low.
installer_action: Review array layout against winter sun path; consider optimisers or panel relocation.

title: Inverter clipping on sunny days
owner_explanation: On the sunniest days your inverter is capped, so some solar energy is lost.
installer_action: Review inverter sizing against the array; consider an inverter upgrade.

title: Array exceeds 133% of inverter rating
owner_explanation: Your solar array is larger than the inverter can normally accept under industry guidelines.
installer_action: Check against the CEC design guideline (array no more than 133% of inverter rating) and STC eligibility.

title: Battery capacity below warranty curve
owner_explanation: Your battery holds noticeably less energy than its warranty allows for its age. This may support a warranty claim.
installer_action: Lodge a manufacturer warranty claim with SunLedger evidence; check firmware and battery module health.

title: Battery holds less than the quoted capacity
owner_explanation: Since installation your battery has held noticeably less energy than the usable capacity on your quote, which your price and rebate were based on.
installer_action: Check module count, stack configuration and firmware capacity setting against the quoted usable capacity; rectify or offer a remedy.

title: Battery capacity fading fast
owner_explanation: Your battery is still within warranty, but it is losing capacity faster than expected.
installer_action: Monitor monthly; check operating temperature and firmware.

title: Battery efficiency has dropped
owner_explanation: Your battery loses more energy than it should between charging and discharging.
installer_action: Check battery and inverter firmware and ventilation; raise with manufacturer if persistent.
